description: Emplacement des barrettes de stationnement de la Ville de Grenoble is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Grenoble. This dataset contains all the parking spaces on Grenoble specifying the fare zone, the location and the type of places (spur, battle or length). Coverage: Ville de Grenoble. The portal shows the English title as "Location of the parking bars of the City of Grenoble" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Grenoble. Its keywords include zone, stationnement. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
